source_landmarks.title: Analysis of Sagittal Thoracic Inlet Measures in Relation to Anterior Access to the Cervicothoracic Junction

measurement.quantity: 3D length in sagittal CT plane, not AP depth

model_proxy.explanation: T1.tail is an interpolated superior endplate control; sternum.head is a schematic jugular notch, not a verified manubrium apex

source_landmarks.title: Evaluation of anatomical pelvic parameters between normal, healthy men and women using three-dimensional computed tomography

measurement.quantity: S1 superior endplate centre relative to hip-axis centre, projected sagittal plane
measurement.from: midpoint of bilateral femoral head centres
measurement.study_frame: anterior pelvic plane corrected to 0 degrees
measurement.source_table: Table 1, page 4 of 7; reported +/- spreads are TWO standard deviations, not one

model_proxy.explanation: Model femur heads and sacrum-tail positions are skeletal control points, and APP anatomical-frame registration has not been demonstrated

acceptance_requirements: Independently verify model endplate-centre and manubrium-apex points, not schematic stick endpoints
Register pelvic APP frame (axis sign, anatomical tilt, both ASIS and pubic symphysis) separately from standing-pose coordinates
Resolve stature and cohort transfer to 1.82 m male, do not scale unvalidated mean positions
Cross-check independent second source and per-region thoracic wedging, costal cartilage and S1 sagittal geometry
Never treat two study means, cohort range or proxy numerical pass as anatomical acceptance
